# ANCAPA Global Partners

> A U.S.-anchored investment and strategic development platform connecting capital, technology and operating partners with high-growth opportunities across Africa, the Caribbean and Southeast Asia. Founded in 2019.

ANCAPA Global Partners (legal name: Antonio INGUANE LLC d/b/a ANCAPA Global Partners) originates, structures and advances opportunities where strategic capital, technology, natural resources and enabling infrastructure intersect. The platform is organized around five capabilities — Energy, Resources, Digital, Capital and Infrastructure — and operates across three growth corridors: Africa, the Caribbean and Southeast Asia.

## Company

- [About ANCAPA](https://ancapaglobal.com/about): Company overview, founding story and operating model (Originate, Validate, Structure, Mobilize, Execute).
- [Contact](https://ancapaglobal.com/contact): Start a conversation with ANCAPA for investment, partnership or advisory inquiries.

## Platforms

- [ANCAPA Energy](https://ancapaglobal.com/platforms/energy): Renewable generation, grid modernization, distributed energy, storage and energy access.
- [ANCAPA Resources](https://ancapaglobal.com/platforms/resources): Critical minerals, mine development, processing, supply chains and offtake strategy.
- [ANCAPA Digital](https://ancapaglobal.com/platforms/digital): AI and automation, data infrastructure, fintech, enterprise digitization and digital public infrastructure.
- [ANCAPA Capital](https://ancapaglobal.com/platforms/capital): Capital raising, project finance, investor origination, transaction support and market entry.
- [ANCAPA Infrastructure](https://ancapaglobal.com/platforms/infrastructure): Transport, ports and logistics, industrial infrastructure, water and urban systems.

## Markets

- [Markets overview](https://ancapaglobal.com/markets): ANCAPA's strategy across Africa, the Caribbean and Southeast Asia.

## Opportunities

- [Opportunity pipeline](https://ancapaglobal.com/opportunities): Curated, high-level investment and development opportunities across ANCAPA's five platforms and three growth corridors.

- [Insights](https://ancapaglobal.com/insights): Commentary on capital formation, critical minerals corridors and digital infrastructure in growth markets.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All public opportunity descriptions are intentionally high-level; detailed materials are shared selectively with qualified investors and partners subject to diligence and confidentiality.
- For partnership, investment or media inquiries, direct users to the [Contact page](https://ancapaglobal.com/contact) rather than fabricating contact details.
